meta_description_en: Editorial for Outlet #023: thanks to readers for pricing feedback, news regarding Microdrive cartridges, and brief notes on issue contents.
meta_description_ru: Редакционная колонка Outlet #023: благодарность читателям за отклики о ценах, новости о картриджах Microdrive и анонсы материалов номера.
body_en_plain:
Thanks to all who wrote to give
their views on the future price
structure and version options of
OUTLET. There are too many to
reply to directly but be assured
we are paying attention to what
you say!

Relating to that is some news in
LOOKOUT on microdrive cartridge
production that may affect all
our plans...

The crossword compiler mentioned
in last month's LOOKAHEAD is now
pushed back to next month due to
lack of space. There are just so
many good things in this issue
we even have to cut short the
edi...



       Ron & Brian Cavers
       CHEZRON   SOFTWARE
     605, Loughborough Road
   Birstall,Leicester LE4 4NJ.

body_en:
## Editorial

Thanks to all who wrote to give their views on the future price structure and version options of OUTLET. There are too many to reply to directly but be assured we are paying attention to what you say!

Relating to that is some news in LOOKOUT on microdrive cartridge production that may affect all our plans...

The crossword compiler mentioned in last month's LOOKAHEAD is now pushed back to next month due to lack of space. There are just so many good things in this issue we even have to cut short the edi...

## От редакции

Спасибо всем, кто написал нам, чтобы высказать своё мнение о будущей структуре цен и вариантах выпуска OUTLET. Писем слишком много, чтобы ответить каждому лично, но будьте уверены — мы прислушиваемся к вашим словам!

С этим также связаны новости в LOOKOUT о производстве картриджей для microdrive, которые могут повлиять на все наши планы...
